about.title: About
about.footer: Local-first — nothing here leaves this device unless you choose to export or share it.

dataNetwork.title: Data & network
dataNetwork.intro: SHOS is on-device only — nothing is ever sent to a server SHOS runs. Two features do call a third party directly from your device to do their job. Both are listed here exactly, and can be turned off.
dataNetwork.addressLookupDesc: “Use current location” and address autocomplete (Contacts, My Profile, Clinic Visits, Encounters) send a typed address or your GPS coordinates to OpenStreetMap’s free Nominatim service to look up a real address or place name. Off: you can still type an address by hand, just without suggestions or auto-lookup.
dataNetwork.updateCheckDesc: On the installed Android app only, checks GitHub’s public API on launch for a newer build. Reveals your IP address to GitHub, nothing else. Off: you can still check manually from the About screen.
dataNetwork.sendReportsDesc: Settings > Developer tools > Error log’s own "Report a problem" box always saves your note on-device. If you set a URL here, tapping Send there ALSO sends just that typed text to it directly — no export step, no email client, and nothing else about you or your device. Leave blank to keep it local-only.

widgets.title: Widgets
widgets.intro: Widgets appear on your home screen and lock screen.
widgets.nextDoseDesc: Shows medication name + next dose time
widgets.refillDueDesc: Shows count + next medication needing refill
widgets.lastTestDesc: Shows last STI test date + when a retest is due
widgets.cycleDesc: Shows cycle day, phase and next period
widgets.clinicCardDesc: Shows the next appointment, its location and test count
widgets.quickAddEncounterDesc: Tap to open Add Encounter form
widgets.quickAddContactDesc: Tap to open Add Contact form
widgets.quickAddMedicationDesc: Tap to open Log Medication form
widgets.shortcutOnly: Shortcut only — no data to hide
widgets.privacyNoteBody: Widgets are visible on the lock screen without authentication.

notifHistory.title: Notification history
notifHistory.clearConfirm: This clears the whole notification history — there's no getting it back.
notifHistory.empty: Nothing's fired yet. Real reminders (and the test notification) show up here the moment they actually deliver.

clinicalEvidence.title: Clinical evidence
clinicalEvidence.intro: Sources behind statements this app makes. These ship with the app and cannot be edited or removed — if a claim here matters to you, this is where to check it rather than take the app’s word for it.
clinicalEvidence.footer: These are third-party documents and are not maintained by this app. Each one was opened and read on the date shown against it, so a reference that has since been revised, moved or withdrawn will not say so here — this is a snapshot taken on that date, not a live feed. If a claim here matters to you, open the source and check it rather than take this screen’s word for it either way.

backup.title: Backup & Export
backup.intro: Everything here makes a copy of your data or brings one back in — nothing here ever leaves this device unless you choose to send it somewhere yourself.
backup.sampleWarning: Heads up: {count} of the records in this export are still SHOS's made-up sample data, not yours. Clear it first if this file is going to a clinic or a new phone — it's in Settings → Support → Developer tools.

guide.title: Guide
guide.intro: Where things live and what the less-obvious features do — not a feature-by-feature walkthrough, just answers to "where do I find X."

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.intro: Plain-language explanations of the clinical shorthand used elsewhere in this app — informational, not personalised medical advice.

errorLog.title: Error log
errorLog.intro: On-device only — nothing here is ever sent anywhere automatically. Export produces a plain text file you can choose to share yourself, e.g. in a bug report.
errorLog.clearConfirm: This clears the whole error log — there's no getting it back.
errorLog.reportWithEndpoint: Not a crash, just something that seems off? Write it below and tap Send — it's saved here AND sent, just this text, to the address set in Settings > Data & network.
errorLog.reportWithoutEndpoint: Not a crash, just something that seems off? Note it here — it's added to this same log so it's not forgotten. Set an address in Settings > Data & network to also send it directly.
errorLog.placeholder: What happened, and what did you expect instead?
errorLog.empty: No errors logged. A real uncaught error or crash will show up here automatically.

manageLists.title: Manage lists
manageLists.registriesIntro: Shared vocabularies used across Contacts, Encounters, Testing, and Clinic Visits — rename or archive an entry directly, rather than only through whichever picker happens to reference it.
manageLists.optionsIntro: Add, rename, or reorder the simple option lists used across the app — no code, no waiting on a rebuild. Changes here are permanent on this device and survive future app updates.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.menstrualTrackingDesc: Adds a Cycle/Contraception/Pregnancy tab under Healthcare. Off by default — turning it on doesn't depend on any other setting.
preferences.hidePregnancyDesc: Keeps Cycle and Contraception, removes Pregnancy specifically — regardless of profile gender. A record you already have stays reachable by tapping it directly.
preferences.tabOrderDesc: Reorder Contacts, Encounter, Medication, and Healthcare — Home always stays fixed in the centre.
preferences.tabOrderReload: Tab order needs a reload to apply.

privacy.title: Privacy & Security
privacy.noCloud: SHOS has no account, no server, and no cloud sync — everything below only ever exists on this device. That's not just a preference you could turn off: there's genuinely nowhere else for it to go. Many comparable apps route usage data through third-party analytics or advertising services; this one structurally can't.
